items.title: The Missing Teddy Bear
items.description: Mia's teddy bear is missing, and a trail of golden sparkles leads her and Rosie on a midnight search. A gentle story about kindness and helping others.

items.title: The Mysterious Doll at Midnight
items.description: Mia hears a tiny voice at midnight and finds that her rag doll Rosie can talk, and that a golden star is waiting in the toy chest.

items.title: Linya Trese
items.description: A BPO graveyard-shift agent watches the forbidden 3 AM line ring one desk closer each night.

items.title: Mahina ang Tiktik
items.description: A night-patrol tanod is relieved that the tiktik's call sounds far away, until the faint tik-tik comes from his own wife's throat.

items.title: Ang Ilaw sa Laot
items.description: A capsized fisherman follows a santelmo to shore, finds his mother crying over his slippers, and realizes he is the light now.

items.title: Tabi-tabi Po
items.description: A family flattens a punso to build their house in Cavite. The nuno thanks them: their new house is his bigger punso.

items.title: Bote, Diyaryo, at Alaala
items.description: A 3 AM junk buyer pays cash for painful memories, and the narrator learns what his mother has already sold.
